listing.name: UFO: Enemy Unknown / X-COM: UFO Defense (OpenXcom)
listing.summary: Set up UFO: Enemy Unknown / X-COM: UFO Defense through its upstream OpenXcom player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.
listing.original_game_title: UFO: Enemy Unknown / X-COM: UFO Defense

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use your own complete unmodified original UFO/XCOM data folders. XcomUtil-modified originals can fail. Copy the original subfolders into OpenXcom’s UFO subdirectory, keeping their hierarchy; TFTD files are not UFO data. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: Use the official upstream download/setup route or a complete already prepared OpenXcom player, keeping its common data and standard mod resources. No GitHub release package was observed. Complete original-data and game selection through upstream before saving the player entry. Register openxcom.exe with its installation folder as working directory, retaining the upstream game selection rather than inventing a fixed argument. The upstream Windows installer may copy a detected Steam original when you deliberately run it.

steps.title: Add the game and manage your files
steps.instruction: Finish setup with the project’s tools before adding the game. Portcove saves your selected executable, working folder and launch arguments; choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage this game’s files, original files and profile. Removing its registration leaves those files in place. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, data migration or file deletion for this external copy. Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Other platforms need their own supported application and setup instructions.

steps.title: Choose an official nightly package
steps.instruction: In OpenXcom’s Nightly GitHub workflow, choose a successful upstream run. Download the Linux x64 or Mac artifact. On Linux unpack the ZIP and start the AppImage. On Mac unpack the outer ZIP and use Mac Archive Utility on the inner Mac ZIP, then open openxcom.app on Intel or Apple Silicon.

steps.title: Prepare this title’s original data
steps.instruction: Copy the data subfolders from your UFO: Enemy Unknown or X-COM: UFO Defense installation into UFO inside the OpenXcom data or user folder. In the OpenXcom Mods menu, select the master game for this title.

warnings: Keep the two original games and their campaigns distinct even if they share one player/profile. Back up with OpenXcom closed before changing runtime or mods.

references.title: Keep your originals and game data
references.instruction: Windows normally uses the actual Documents/OpenXcom user/config location; an installation-local user folder and explicit -data/-user/-config choices can change the searched locations. Preserve every actual selected data/user/config folder, including UFO/TFTD resources, mods, savegames and screenshots. Keep the two original games and their campaigns distinct even if they share one player/profile. Back up with OpenXcom closed before changing runtime or mods.

references.title: Back up the actual OpenXcom profile
references.instruction: On Linux keep ~/.local/share/openxcom and ~/.config/openxcom or their XDG overrides. On Mac keep ~/Library/Application Support/OpenXcom or the configured XDG directory. Preserve originals, settings, mods and saves before replacing an upstream nightly.
